name: Roy
source:
A veteran of the latest World War, where he lost an arm. Now he wears a biomechanical arm, but is still considered a cripple by the Army, so he feels betrayed and bitter.

He’s a tough man who speaks little and trusts no one, but who is loyal to the bone to the ones who earn his respect. He comes across as harsh, but when he relaxes he can be really kind and good-humored. He has a deep voice and a really loud laugh.

[From Casting Call]
